releaseMode: single consolidated release; nothing reaches main until all stages pass

stages.name: Exam interaction stability
evidence: Exam/draft lifecycle observers only watch direct body children.
Family/share/trajectory/onboarding enhancements avoid document-wide subtree observers.
Draft restoration dispatches score:draft-restored explicitly.
Score-mode synchronization is idempotent.
Observer regression tests are in test/observer-stability.test.js.

stages.name: Trajectory-first multi-exam analysis and sharing
evidence: For 2+ exams the UI answers current position, recent movement, and subject contributors before raw scores.
Percentile is only used when both rank and participants exist; otherwise comparisons remain rank-only with caveats.
Share creation explicitly separates single-exam and trajectory scope; a single live share remains pinned to the chosen exam ID.

Trajectory shares include an interactive chronological exam timeline: past exams are visually distinct from the current exam, desktop click/hover affordances are present, and Android/touch uses horizontal scrolling plus tap selection.
Selecting a timeline node shows that exam's total score, school/class rank and six subject details.
Integration and UI-contract tests cover scoped sharing and the timeline contract.

stages.name: Independent-family invitation and recovery
evidence: Eligible owner can create an expiring high-entropy invitation for a completely separate family.
Invitee chooses family name, username, password and first student; invitation-created families cannot recursively invite new families.
Family isolation is tested: inviter cannot read the invited family's student data.
Account creation returns a one-time recovery code while KV stores only its hash.
Username + recovery code resets password, rotates the recovery code and invalidates prior sessions.
Inviter can issue a 15-minute one-time recovery link only for a family they invited; inviter never receives old/new password.
Invitation and recovery indexes store minimal issuance/usage metadata.

stages.name: Full release gate
evidence: package.json, package-lock.json and Worker APP_VERSION are 0.2.0.
Worker entrypoint is src/v020.js and onboarding/share v2 routes are wired.
